records.title: Development of Inland Waterways in Maharashtra
details: a to c: Inland Waterways Authority of India (IWAI), an autonomous organisation under the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways, has prepared the feasibility report of all the 14 NWs in the State. The feasible 7 NWs with navigable length of 662.97 km have been identified for development and the action plan for the same has been shared with Government of Maharashtra.

records.title: National Mission on Edible oil.
details: a to e: Solapur district in Maharashtra has been given target of one edible oil production unit in 2025-26 State Government of Maharashtra has not yet approved any post-harvest infrastructure.

records.title: Completion of Jal Jeevan Mission
details: a to d: Hon'ble Finance Minister during her budget speech 2025-26 has announced extension of Jal Jeevan Mission until 2028 with enhanced total outlay is under consideration of the Government

records.title: LOANS SANCTIONED UNDER DIFFERENT CATEGORIES OF MUDRA SCHEME
details: Sir, the hon. Member's case does not seem to fit in the way in which the banking operations works. But, if in case this is happening in her area, I will take it up very seriously. This is absolutely not the way in which MUDRA loan disbursement happens. The banks cannot say that there are people who have defaulted - one or two in a village - and so the whole village will suffer. This is not the written practice. I ake the words of the hon. Members very seriously. I would like to take the inputs and get into the details of it.
